result_summary.title: Analytics Dashboard showing wrong residency flags
result_summary.description: We are seeing a data residency flag mismatch on the Analytics Dashboard in our staging environment (LATAM). This is definitely because of an incomplete rollback from the last deployment. We need this fixed immediately as it's affecting 230 users and has a high business impact.
